messages:
incident-bot: Pager opened -> HIGH error rate on /v1/generate (hosted-api prod). Severity: possible service degradation. Paging eng-oncall. Trigger: kv-client timeouts and backpressure spike.

maria: I'm on it — joining the bridge. starting scans across pools and recent deploys.

alex: seeing a tail of 5xxs and queue-length growth on recip-shard gce-01. digging logs now.

maria: quick repro locally: lots of redis timeouts then request spikes hitting fallback model path. looks like connection pooling regression.

jamal: starting rollback of canary variant (model-v2-canary) to relieve CPU pressure, rolling back at 09:23 UTC. will monitor.

sophie: product: flagged customer-facing incidents — collecting list of affected orgs, will update.

maria: mitigation steps in play: rollback canary, scale up dedicated pool by +3 nodes, and temporarily enable prefix-KV bypass for the problematic prefix. watching metrics.

alex: logs snippet:
```
[09:21:12] ERROR fetch-kv: timeout conn=10.2.3.4:6379 ctx=serve-request id=abc123 retry=1
[09:21:13] WARN backpressure: queue-length=520
[09:21:14] ERROR http: 502 upstream failed
```

maria: bridge created -> <https://call.example.com/1972004512>

ravi: making a hotfix PR to add circuit-breaker + fallback delay inside the kv client: https://git/repo/pull/987 (small change, includes unit tests).

hannah: heads up — I have the handoff in 30m. @maria can you summarize current state and next steps for the incoming oncall?

maria: summary for handoff:
- suspected root cause: connection-pool regression in kv client code introduced in last deploy (pool sizing/checkout logic)
- mitigation taken: rollback canary, scaled pool, enabled bypass for hot prefix
- customer impact: ~2% error rate spike for hosted-api, duration ~18m, partial degradation for streaming completions
- open remediation: hotfix PR (ravi), run full kv integration (maria), telemetry & alert tuning (alex)

hannah: copying action items into tracker now. ACTIONS created:
- ACTION-1972: owner=ravi, due=48h, "add circuit-breaker + unit tests to kv client"
- ACTION-1973: owner=maria, due=24h, "full kv integration tests across regions + canary test"
- ACTION-1974: owner=alex, due=72h, "promote queue-length alert and add conn-error telemetry"

jamal: I'll open a runbook PR to capture the new steps for 'kv-client timeouts' section (scale, rollback, verify org health). PR: https://git/repo/docs/pull/234

sophie: proposing a postmortem meeting: Wed Mar 30 2026 16:00 PT — agenda: timeline, root cause, action owners, runbook updates, customer comms. Thoughts?

ravi: works for me at 16:00 PT.

hannah: I prefer 17:00 PT to include EMEA folks — 17:00 PT ok for me.

maria: 17:00 PT works.

sophie: scheduled: Wed Mar 30 2026 17:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-sre, product, customer-success. Link in doc.

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 09:40 UTC. Final severity: Sev2. Duration: ~19m. Root-cause status: under investigation.

maria: follow-up: I'll draft the timeline and attach relevant logs + the bridge transcript to the postmortem doc. Will link PRs once ready.

hannah: please add a line in the oncall playbook: "After deploys, verify kv-client pool health and run smoke canary for 10m." I'll add as a task.

maria: done — opened doc PR for playbook entry: https://git/repo/docs/pull/235 (includes checklist and sample commands).

alex: alert tuning note: set queue-length alert to trigger at >200 and add a short cooldown to avoid noisy flips; demo alert configured, will promote to prod after test.

sophie: customer comms: I'll coordinate with CS on short blurb and follow-up email for impacted customers.

maria: handing off to @hannah for overnight watch. I'm still reachable if anything pops up. /me signs off from bridge.

hannah: taking over — leaving notes in #eng-oncall-runbooks and will run a quick sanity check in 1h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
